authority.current_names: docs/design/collection-algebra.md#naming-dispositions (current selections; a recorded decision may change them)

concepts.name: Value domain
concepts.role: admissibility; equality and enumeration are separate

concepts.name: Frozen
concepts.model: structural access/lifecycle refinement, not separate collection carrier

laws.name: Representation refinement
laws.statement: Safety implication with typed preconditions; separate progress and error obligations
laws.evidence: definition; no generic executable implementation

laws.name: Observable refinement
laws.statement: Allowed-trace sets model unspecified order; equality is stronger than refinement
laws.evidence: definition; effect/representation counterexamples

laws.name: Stream prefix soundness
laws.statement: Every emitted item justified; completeness must be separately established
laws.evidence: definition; not exercised by the finite model

laws.name: Stable key equivalence
laws.statement: Equivalence classes require reflexivity, symmetry, transitivity and stability
laws.evidence: obligation; the model generates equivalences by construction and does not test this law

laws.name: Quotient congruence
laws.statement: Key-only operations constant on each equivalence class
laws.evidence: finite functions/filters and representative counterexample

laws.name: Validation soundness
laws.statement: Successful admission implies predicate; completeness/termination not inferred
laws.evidence: table of percentage boundary cases; general obligation

laws.name: Typed normalization
laws.statement: Separate raw meaning from valid-output equivalence; explicit embedding for idempotence
laws.evidence: proof obligation; raw-to-integer example and constant-normalizer counterexample

laws.name: Code injectivity
laws.statement: Key-code inverse on image; existing IntKey has stronger full-value laws
laws.evidence: proof obligation; current source mapping, no codec implementation executed

laws.name: Conversion homomorphisms
laws.statement: Total direct image preserves union; injection necessary/sufficient for intersection/difference/XOR; inclusion directions otherwise
laws.evidence: proof argument plus all functions on three keys, each operation separately; bag pushforward of sum

laws.name: Finite set laws
laws.statement: Membership laws, explicit universe and count formulas
laws.evidence: bounded exhaustive equations and independent sorted merge

laws.name: Representative refinement
laws.statement: Left union/intersection associate; commutation, XOR reassociation, and two absorption/distribution orientations can fail
laws.evidence: pointwise argument, metadata enumeration, pinned left rule

laws.name: Map merge lifting
laws.statement: Lift collision resolver through absence and check totality/definedness
laws.evidence: pointwise proof argument; finite overrides/sum/deletion counterexample

laws.name: Count algebras
laws.statement: Natural sum versus max/min/monus/absolute difference
laws.evidence: pointwise argument, exhaustive small counts and counterexamples

laws.name: Bounded count addition
laws.statement: Either association succeeds iff total fits; errors/traces separate
laws.evidence: nonnegative arithmetic argument and a model with bound M=3

laws.name: Support projection
laws.statement: Preserves sum/max as union and min as intersection; not monus/XOR
laws.evidence: pointwise proof and finite model

laws.name: Free monoid
laws.statement: Concatenation identity/association, occurrence preservation
laws.evidence: word argument and finite words

laws.name: Execution effects
laws.statement: Pure equations do not establish callback/error/drop equivalence
laws.evidence: design obligation; future Rust effect/drop tests required

laws.name: Empty-fiber normalization
laws.statement: Canonical proposed multimap absent iff fiber empty; native maps may differ
laws.evidence: definition and present-empty counterexample

laws.name: Boolean relation composition
laws.statement: Existential witnesses; associative and union-distributive
laws.evidence: witness proof argument and finite Boolean matrices

laws.name: Weighted composition
laws.statement: Sum of products counts derivations; cycle convergence is a separate question in computed sets
laws.evidence: finite double-sum argument; 2×2 matrices with weights 0..2, cross-checked against Boolean composition

laws.name: Partial-bijection closure
laws.statement: Subsets/inverse/composition preserve both uniqueness projections
laws.evidence: proof argument and all small partial bijections

laws.name: Local inverse identities
laws.statement: Identities on domain/range; global finite identity requires finite universe
laws.evidence: proof argument and finite model

laws.name: Checked operations
laws.statement: Union partial definedness associates; checked XOR does not
laws.evidence: subset proof argument; enumeration against validity of the three-way union; explicit conflict counterexample

laws.name: Phase transition
laws.statement: Successful freeze of lawful family preserves denotation, not all representation details
laws.evidence: typed contract; actual Rust transitions not executed

laws.name: Structural versus deep stability
laws.statement: Fixed structure is not fixed heap payload or source revision
laws.evidence: abstract heap counterexample; no Rust aliasing proof

laws.name: Incomplete set knowledge
laws.statement: Sound lower/upper transfer, exact for independent operands; not correlation-complete or error absorption
laws.evidence: inclusion proof; soundness and tightness over all interval realizations on three keys

laws.name: Revisioned overlays
laws.statement: Exact base plus ordered complete suffix; ordered compaction preserves result
laws.evidence: fold decomposition argument; short histories against a last-event-wins reference

laws.name: Difference identities
laws.statement: Ten identities of natural-number monus hold; four set-difference identities fail under the sum and min reading; no finite complete rule set
laws.evidence: case argument; supplementary checks on counts 0..6; non-axiomatizability cited from SRC-PRIOR-SUCIU-DIFFERENCES, not proved

laws.name: Compatibility
laws.statement: Functional pair union iff both mixed products are partial identities; orthogonal implies compatible; not transitive; composition distributes over compatible union
laws.evidence: proof argument; supplementary checks on all 34 partial bijections on three keys

laws.name: Recursive weighted composition
laws.statement: Converges for every program iff the weight semiring is stable; N is not stable; capping commutes with sum and product
laws.evidence: theorem cited from SRC-PRIOR-DATALOGO, not re-proved; instances in the supplementary checks

laws.name: Context in result keys
laws.statement: A reused result is keyed by every context component it depends on; reuse never upgrades a status
laws.evidence: argument from FM-REFINE; three-outcome toy model in the supplementary checks; incident SRC-PRIOR-SPICEDB-CVE-2026-55866
